items.text: Throughout the pandemic, I've helped facilitate regular check-ins between the MN delegation & @MNhospitals to gauge their needs & ensure they get federal aid. I was happy to help these efforts & I will keep fighting to help hospitals serve our communities. https://t.co/nrSj6xrtdn

Rates of uninsured folks usually go up during economic downturns. But the federal aid we provided helped more Minnesotans afford health coverage during the height of the pandemic. It's great news – but more must be done to fix worsening racial disparities. https://t.co/d0w8hRJc0T

It’s graduation season! Via @mnsure, 3 options for new grads to get or stay covered with health insurance:
-Get coverage through your employer
-Find a plan at https://t.co/9PwEa4zeKC, MN's health insurance exchange
-Stay on a parent's plan until age 26 
https://t.co/UgMSQPXdH4

It’s wedding season! @MNsure is reminding folks that getting married means you may qualify for a special enrollment period to sign up for health coverage. Learn more here: https://t.co/2TvwDr74Dx https://t.co/lgcilbhPAX

Great news! The #AmericanRescuePlan allowed states to provide extended postpartum Medicaid benefits – and Minnesota has opted in! Medical Assistance will be extended to 7,000 additional new moms in our state. #Delivering4MN  https://t.co/RTo47lEcSG

It is awful – heartbreaking as well as enraging – hearing the stories of women in a post-Roe America unable to receive basic medical interventions from their doctors and pharmacists to manage a miscarriage. This is a violation of patients’ rights.
https://t.co/CcEJf5vczI

Just got notice I’ll be called back to Washington next week to vote on a historic package to lower health care premiums, Rx costs, & energy prices, while closing tax loopholes & lowering the deficit. Democrats are putting #PeopleOverPolitics, and I’m proud to be #Delivering4MN!

The health care premium relief we delivered through the #AmericanRescuePlan made a big difference, resulting in thousands more Minnesotans being able to afford coverage. Extending these expanded subsidies in the #InflationReductionAct is a huge deal! #Delivering4MN

And importantly, it extends the #AmericanRescuePlan's expanded federal subsidies to help people pay health care premiums – helping millions of Americans afford coverage. 

Democrats are putting #PeopleOverPolitics & #Delivering4MN! https://t.co/cFeXKP1Irf (3/3)

The Inflation Reduction Act cuts health care costs for Minnesotans – from capping Medicare out-of-pocket expenses to lowering @MNsure premiums, Democrats are #Delivering4MN. 

More details: https://t.co/hNt5FRFf9k

Important reporting on the 85 “crisis pregnancy centers” in Minnesota – many of which aren’t required to comply with data privacy laws. Patients in need of reproductive health care should visit licensed regulated clinics. https://t.co/5uVIQo6SYz

The Trump-era "public charge" rule discriminated against people in need of important public services like Medicaid coverage, housing, and food assistance. I commend the Biden administration for rescinding this bad policy! 
https://t.co/lvcymxOneP

I’ve heard firsthand from physicians and patients how #PriorAuth in our health care system can delay care, worsen health outcomes, & burden seniors & their families. Proud to support the bipartisan Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act to deliver better care for seniors. https://t.co/JhIG2B2jAY

Great news: Starting in 2023, Medicare Part B premiums will decrease for the first time in more than a decade! Democrats are committed to cutting costs for Americans, and this reduction will have a significant impact for Minnesota seniors. https://t.co/FRf6umo8or

Thanks to the federal Inflation Reduction Act, there will be larger tax credits available for people who buy private health plans through @MNSure – meaning Minnesotans will save a LOT on premiums next year!
 
Democrats are proud to be #Delivering4MN.

For too long, affordable health care has been out of reach for too many Minnesota families. That’s why Democrats passed the #InflationReductionAct to lower health insurance premiums – saving you money and putting #PeopleOverPolitics. https://t.co/f2M17r7OEo

The time is now to #GetCovered for 2023. Enroll by Dec. 15 for coverage beginning on Jan. 1! Compare plans & get help at https://t.co/Rvk2QGH5qv. 
https://t.co/ivD8LxQS7G

Democrats are committed to lowering health care costs. The #InflationReductionAct extended discounts to more families. Make sure to check if you’re eligible for lower premiums before @mnsure open enrollment ends! More info: https://t.co/N7fp1zPKDf

Today, Dec. 15, is the last day to enroll in health insurance through @mnsure in order for your coverage to start Jan. 1. (You can still sign up after this deadline through Jan. 15, but your coverage will begin Feb. 1.) https://t.co/Rvk2QGpuyX https://t.co/1JqwHtf9SO
Need new health insurance, but missed the Dec. 15 deadline? You can still sign up through @mnsure through Jan. 15, 2023 – your coverage will kick in on Feb. 1! https://t.co/2QtOsLAEPy

This week, @HouseGOP passed a bill that would interfere with the care pregnant women receive from their doctors and criminalize doctors for providing abortion care. Republicans aren’t leaving abortion to the states — they’re impeding doctors who are caring for their patients.

More than 16,000 East Metro residents access health coverage through the Affordable Care Act. The Republican budget would cause premiums in MN-04 to rise by an average of $1,560 per year — a 41% spike. The GOP budget gives huge tax breaks to billionaires, but leaves working people with a big bill.

The House Republican budget scheme would raise healthcare costs for all of us and cause nearly 14 million Americans to lose their health coverage entirely. The only beneficiaries of this plan are the Trump family and their billionaire donors.

The use of bunker-busting bombs by Israeli Defense Forces to target civilian hospitals must stop immediately. Strikes on civilians are completely unacceptable. The people of Gaza are on the brink of starvation, and Israeli actions to bomb hospitals are driving the region further from peace. The United States and the international community must focus on delivering humanitarian aid to those in need as quickly as possible. https://t.co/zNMZNak3gX

This is outrageous. The Trump admin is giving permission to hospitals to turn away pregnant women whose health is in danger. 
https://t.co/Z83avmDL1X
